objective: Compare original CPOP and a finite-grid continuous-linear interval-average adaptation, with matched point-average enumeration ablation
primary_metric: request-window interval-average curve RMSE in kW
secondary_metrics: threshold onset and target error with joint-valid denominator
response false positives and missed detections
raw-integral eta error common to methods
noise: independent zero-mean Gaussian interval-power errors; two sigmas share standardized noise within seed/mechanism/delta
independence: 20 independent seed blocks; 160 base mechanisms; 960 paired observation variants, not 960 independent events
enumeration_rank_rule: same subset family: exclude if either point or average design is numerically rank-deficient or p>n; QR tolerance 1e-10 times max diagonal
penalty: beta=2 log(n) in standardized RSS, same for point/average and original CPOP; no outcome-based tuning
CPOP: original R package from CRAN, unrestricted number of knots on same candidate grid plus endpoints, minseglen=0 and exact pruning; runtime and package provenance recorded separately
matched_ablation: Grid_point and Grid_average use the same subset list, linear model family, penalty, endpoint extrapolation, exact QR enumeration and tie rule; only the observation operator changes
RIDE_template: original source imported read-only; structures 0/1/2, n_starts=3, BIC fallback detection (not calibrated LR), no bootstrap intervals, no true labels supplied, curve projected through original average operator before common features
feature_target: frozen F0 threshold+dwell on noiseless interval-average observations; t0=0, t1=1800 seconds, threshold .15kW, target 90% request, dwell >=30 seconds
F1: invoke original frozen segment solver separately in pre/request/post phases, min dwell30s and penalty3sigma^2log(n_phase); explicit W30 adapter, original source unchanged
energy: all methods use common raw observed interval integral over request, never fitted curve integral
physical_timing: not scored as identified physical timing; coarse observations can be nonunique, demonstrated separately
missing_censoring: not in this finite primary panel; separate interface checks reject missing input or mark unavailable instead of silently interpolating
decision: retain negative results; no test-seed tuning, mechanism truth used only by evaluator, no claim of new algorithm novelty or real resource accuracy
stop: one frozen primary comparison; no automatic larger sample or hyperparameter search to win
